facts: Parties: Yarrow Logistics plc (Buyer), Merrion Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Vantage Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 13 June 2027; Closing is scheduled for 19 August 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 25% of the Purchase Price, being $37,500,000. The Purchase Price is $120,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 24 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Northgate Pharma plc threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
